task_description: Phase 6a LOCAL, GIT-BASED knowledge & capability sharing for APIA: implement four deterministic, off-model, strictly-local capabilities that share VIA THE GIT REPO (committed files) exactly like .apia/knowledge/ already does - (1) portable VERSIONED KNOWLEDGE PACKS with a safe no-clobber import merge, (2) shared ORG/TEAM PROFILES layered onto the existing config.yml with LOCAL-overrides-win precedence, (3) a LOCAL PLUGIN/EXTENSION contract (adapters/scanners/shapes as committed files, discovered by the off-model scripts, no download/marketplace), and (4) a CAPABILITY MANIFEST reusing ingest.doctor() + adapter/scanner/shape detection. Build a new off-model module .apia/scripts/share.py that REUSES the existing engines (ingest/scan/scaffold/verify) and wires a plugin loader into them; add the model-facing surface (concise Tier-0 + a Tier-1 apia-share prompt + an apia-share skill) so it is usable on VS 2022; update docs (ARCHITECTURE/USAGE/PROOF/README/adapters README). EXPLICITLY DROP former Phase 6b (external/hosted platform: MCP servers exposing APIA, cross-org APIs, collaborative-workspace services, marketplace distribution) - the roadmap ENDS at local git-based sharing with external/hosted sharing stated as intentionally OUT OF SCOPE, not deferred. Works for BOTH Python and C++. Add real tests (pack round-trip + safe-merge + version handling; profile precedence; plugin discovery/load incl. malformed graceful-failure; manifest content; a new no-LLM/no-network guard) and keep all 296 existing tests green.
